video_description:
Rom Flasher went live — a raw, unedited session about Android flashing, custom ROMs and the tools I keep around for every install on this channel.

No cuts, no script. It's me talking through the side of phone modding I actually live in: fastboot, recovery, ROM zips, drivers and the awkward moment when a phone won't boot. If you've been flashing a while you'll know the rhythm. If you're new, treat it as a look over my shoulder before you try it yourself.

The real value here is the file list. Everything I mention in the stream — the Android APK tool, the Windows PC tool, the ADB and Fastboot platform files, the driver pack and the hardbrick guide — sits in the links below, unchanged and free. I run the same files on my own POCO X7 Pro, so grab them once and you're sorted for the next few flashes.

🎬 In This Stream
- Live talk about custom ROM flashing, recovery and fastboot work
- Why a clean flash usually beats a dirty one
- The tools I run on Windows and straight from the phone
- Unbricking, and why the hardbrick guide matters more than anything else here

Honestly, the biggest cause of a dead phone isn't a bad ROM. It's the wrong file, a missing driver or a cable that drops halfway through a write. Watch the process, don't race it, and keep a copy of your important data on a PC before you start.

📦 Worth knowing: this is a live recording, so there's no step-by-step walkthrough in it. Pair it with a proper install video before you touch fastboot on a real device.
